units.source_text: 源氏内大臣回到西殿，暂不走进内室去，却在窗前躺下，耽入沉思。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, returned to the western wing, but for the moment he did not go into the inner chamber; instead he lay down by the window and sank into deep thought.

units.source_text: 他教人把灯笼挂在远处，命几个侍女在旁侍候，和她们闲谈。

en.t: He had the lanterns hung at a distance, ordered several gentlewomen to wait beside him, and chatted idly with them.

units.source_text: 他自己也感觉到：“我作乱伦之恋而自寻烦恼的老毛病，还是照旧呢。”

en.t: He himself felt it too: "My old habit of tormenting myself with forbidden love is still just as it was."

units.source_text: 又想：“向梅壶女御求爱，实在太不应该！

en.t: Then he thought, "To seek the love of the Lady of the Plum Pavilion is truly something I should never do!

units.source_text: 从前那桩事，讲到罪过，比这件事深重得多。

en.t: That affair long ago, if one speaks of sin, was far more serious than this matter.

units.source_text: 然而那时年幼无知，神佛亦原谅我。

en.t: Yet at that time I was young and ignorant, and even the gods and Buddhas forgave me.
But how could I commit such a fault again now?"

units.source_text: 想到这里，又觉得自己于此道已可放心，毕竟修养加深，不会再蹈覆辙了。

en.t: Thinking this far, he again felt that he could now trust himself in such matters; after all, his discipline had deepened, and he would not repeat the same mistake.
